task: VG150 SGDet, predicted objects; cached frozen VG-trained native detector; controlled relation-head adaptation
not_claimed: new detector trained from scratch in this run
test_policy: No test access until preregistered confirmation gate; no test rerun/tuning

cache.train_augmentation: fixed evaluation transform; same for all arms
cache.dtype_policy: FP16 only if probe max logit error <0.02, otherwise FP32

confirmation.resource_admission: Before confirmation, measured maximum screening epoch duration times planned epochs plus test allowance, with25% margin, must fit original absolute remaining budget; otherwise preserve screening and block admission without relaxing scientific gate

selection.fallback: best mR@50 with guardrail failure explicitly reported

adjustment_policy: No core/config changes inside a locked run. Technical failures may be repaired with new source lock and explicit audit. Scientific changes become a new preregistered experiment; tests remain unopened.
caption_stage: Required follow-on: audit external test overlap, train fresh caption-clean detector/SGG, fixed Qwen14B and matched prompt budgets; never use benchmark weights as contamination-free caption model without proof
satellite_stage: Only after natural-image evidence; independent domain training

batching.criterion: unchanged per-image normalization; sum losses / effective_batch16
batching.tail: same as original: final incomplete effective batch still divided by16
batching.dropout: different RNG trajectory from micro1; all four arms freshly initialized, no old native reuse
batching.validation: original singleton FP32 evaluator, same predictions/IoU/GC metrics
batching.order: original seeded shard and intra-shard shuffle; contiguous microgroups across shards
batching.search: one adopted configuration; no further batch/precision search inside this run
